title: Ham's descendants: 30 names (Cush to Hamathite)
summary: Numbered list of Ham's descendants: his four sons (Cush, Mizraim, Put, Canaan), then the sons of Cush, Raamah, Mizraim and Canaan, numbered 1 to 30. Canaan's list (20 Sidon through 30 Hamathite) sits in a separate block on the right.

text.text: 1 Cush → 5 Seba, 6 Havilah, 7 Sabtah, 8 Raamah, 9 Sabteca
2 Mizraim → 13 Ludim, 14 Anamim, 15 Lehabim, 16 Naphtuhim, 17 Pathrusim, 18 Casluhim, 19 Caphtorim
4 Canaan → 20 Sidon, 21 Heth, 22 Jebusite, 23 Amorite, 24 Girgashite, 25 Hivite, 26 Arkite, 27 Sinite, 28 Arvadite, 29 Zemarite, 30 Hamathite

numbers.note: total names listed for Ham's line
